resources.string: Choose a board. Make a note, make your move. Pick up where you left off whenever you like.
6×6 or 9×9. Yours to play offline, too.
Pick up where you left off
Every step is found by looking at a single box.
Boxes are not enough; rows and columns must show a digit\'s only place.
Some cells need their candidates counted until one digit is left.
Singles run out; locked candidates must remove candidates first.
Locked candidates are not enough; pairs must remove candidates.
Both players get the same puzzle; later duel boards and rematches stay at this level.
A short break, or a little more time to think.
Every game starts with a new puzzle that has one solution and needs no guessing.
Your board and notes are here. Continue whenever you are ready.
Every row, column and box is in its place.
The %1$d×%1$d save could not be opened. It is preserved; you can try again or play the other size.
Key, error and finish cues. Off by default; silent while the ringer is muted.
A light tap on entries, mistakes and finishes. Follows the system touch feedback setting.
Choose the app language in Android settings.
The app follows your phone\'s language.
Follows the system Remove animations setting. The board itself never animates.
Saves are kept only on this device. If the app is deleted, the saves are lost.
There is a conflict on the board
Couldn\'t start the game. Your previous save is kept; you can try again.
Couldn\'t open the save. It was not deleted. If you start a new game, the previous save will be kept separately.
Couldn\'t save the game. The open game and the previous save are kept; you can try again.
Given cells can\'t be changed. To add notes, erase the number in this cell first.
No explainable hint was found for this position.
Resolve the board conflicts before asking for a hint.
No explainable hint was found for this board.
Only %3$d can go in row %1$d, column %2$d. The numbers in its row, column and box rule out the other candidates.
In %1$s, %2$d can only go in row %3$d, column %4$d.
In %1$s, %3$d fits only where it crosses %2$s, so %3$d is removed from the rest of %2$s.
In %1$s, two cells can only hold %2$d and %3$d, so both are removed from the other cells of %1$s.
In %1$s, %2$d and %3$d fit only the same two cells, so those cells lose their other candidates.
That leaves only %3$d for row %1$d, column %2$d.
So in %1$s, %2$d can only go in row %3$d, column %4$d.
The save of this size cannot be opened; it will be kept separately. A new game will start for this size.
The saved game of this size will be replaced by a new game. The game of the other size is kept.
Check the code, add your name and join.
The live game server isn\'t configured yet.
Create a room and send the code to your friend.
Enter the code or link your friend sent.
Same puzzle. First correct finish wins.
Score with correct moves for 90 seconds.
The unreadable save won\'t be overwritten. You can keep it separately and start a new session.
Keep the save and start over
The server couldn\'t recover the result. No win or loss was declared. Your local race data is kept.
The server couldn\'t recover the result. No win or loss was declared. The duel result couldn\'t be verified by the server.
Keep the save and open a new session
If you leave, you lose the match. The session is kept until the server confirms.
A request to leave the room will be sent to the server. The session is kept until it confirms.
Keep the save and switch to a new session?
The current session record is kept separately on the device. A new session can\'t automatically take back your seat in the old room.
Couldn\'t save the session on this device. The open state and the previous save are kept. Try saving again without closing the app.
Waiting for the server to start
The match ended without a result
The server couldn\'t safely continue this match.
The first correct finish was verified on the server.
Your friend left the room; a rematch can\'t be requested. You can open a new room.
You asked for a rematch; waiting for your friend to reconnect.
Your friend is disconnected. You can ask for a rematch; they need to reconnect for a new match.
You asked for a rematch; waiting for your friend.
A connection to the server is needed for a rematch.
Time\'s up; waiting for the server\'s result
The server board differs from your local work. Your local notes and history are kept until you choose.
Couldn\'t open the live game save. It is kept and won\'t be overwritten.
Waiting for confirmation of leaving the room.
Enter a valid HTTPS address or an allowed local development address.
Wait for the pending request to finish first.
Couldn\'t preserve the old session record. Didn\'t switch to a new session; you can try again.
The action couldn\'t be applied. Check the name, room code and connection; if a request is pending, wait for it to finish.
The request couldn\'t be sent safely.
The server response timed out; will reconnect.
No valid response from the server; will reconnect.
Can\'t reach the server. Will reconnect.
Can\'t reach the server. Your local race changes are kept.
Can\'t reach the server. Will reconnect; duel moves and the result are waiting for server confirmation.
Can\'t return to this session. To join a new invite, keep the save and open a new session.
You need to leave the current room before joining a new invite.
The room is full. You can use another invite.
The room closed or the server restarted. You can\'t return to the room with this session.
You can\'t return to the room with this session. The local save is kept.
The server isn\'t accepting new actions right now. Wait a moment and try again.
The session is syncing. Your local changes are kept.
The server didn\'t accept the action. Check the connection and the room state.
